surge_diagram.title: An alarm changes over time
surge_diagram.instruction: Follow the shape of a surge.
surge_diagram.takeaway:
A surge can feel endless while you’re inside it.

But intensity can change over time.
surge_diagram.note: Illustrative pattern; timing and intensity vary.
surge_diagram.completedAnnouncement: Easing. Reached the end. The pattern: A surge can feel endless, but intensity changes over time.

two_dial_sandbox.title: Two dials shape your week
two_dial_sandbox.instruction: Adjust demand and recovery to see how the system reacts.
two_dial_sandbox.takeaway:
Demand alone doesn’t decide how the week feels.

Recovery changes what the same demand costs you.
two_dial_sandbox.completedAnnouncement: All four states discovered. The pattern: Demand alone doesn’t decide how the week feels. Recovery changes what the same demand costs you.

HL.title: Deadline crunch
HL.body: High demand with little recovery can keep the system running hot.

HH.title: Steady rhythm
HH.body: Demand is present, but recovery keeps replenishing capacity.

LH.title: Quiet recharge
LH.body: Lower demand gives recovery room to rebuild.

LL.title: Stalled loop
LL.body: Low demand with little recovery can leave the week feeling flat.
